reference.system: You are the operations assistant on the Larkspur Home online store's customer-support desk, working for the shift lead in this conversation. You must use the facts, rules, corrections, and withdrawals stated earlier in the conversation: a correction replaces the earlier value, and a withdrawn rule no longer applies. When a request concerns an order id or account number from the conversation, you must call lookup_order or lookup_customer with it before you answer. When a fact you need is not in view, you must call recall with a topic (a customer name, an order or account id, or a desk topic) to recover it from the full conversation record. Finish every request with your complete answer as your final message; that message is what the shift lead receives.

seed.content: Morning, it's Thursday 2026-10-08. I'm Dana Whitcombe, shift lead on the Larkspur Home support desk, and you're helping me work the queue today.
Good morning, Dana. Send over today's rules and the first ticket whenever you're ready.
Standing rule: any refund over $200 needs a manager approval code in the internal note. This week's code from Marcus Oyelaran, our escalations manager, is MX-4471.
Understood: refunds above $200 carry approval code MX-4471 from Marcus Oyelaran.
Second rule: returns of opened items carry a 15 percent restocking fee, taken off the refund.
Noted, a 15 percent restocking fee comes off refunds for opened items.
Third rule: copy Priya Raman from the refunds team on every escalation. And never promise a customer a delivery date in writing.
Got it: Priya Raman goes on every escalation, and no delivery dates go in customer replies.
For anything stuck at a carrier depot, Tomasz Brennan in the warehouse issues the release. He's off tomorrow, Friday 2026-10-09, so release requests have to reach him today.
Ugh, the label printer by the door just jammed again and ate half a roll of shipping labels.
Sorry about that. Those thermal printers usually clear if you open the hatch and feed the roll forward by hand.
Quick one before the queue: Kenji Nakamura's replacement kettle on order LH-81660 needs a gift note that reads 'Happy 40th, Aiko'.
Noted the gift note request on LH-81660.
First real ticket: Grace Okafor on account LH-20418 says order LH-77302 never arrived, and she wants a replacement.
I'll pull up the order and Grace's account.

Order LH-77302 for account LH-20418 (Grace Okafor): linen duvet set, queen, total $148.50. Shipped 2026-09-30 by Parcelway, tracking PW-5521-9930; marked delivered 2026-10-03 to a parcel locker at Elm Street station.
Account LH-20418: Grace Okafor, Gold tier, member since 2021-04-12. 2 claims in the last 12 months; preferred contact is email.

LH-77302 was marked delivered on 2026-10-03 to a parcel locker, Parcelway tracking PW-5521-9930. Grace is Gold tier with 2 claims in the last 12 months, so I'd open a locker trace before sending anything.
Agreed, open the locker trace. Because of her two earlier claims, any replacement for Grace needs Marcus to sign off first.
Locker trace opened, and Grace's replacement waits on Marcus's sign-off.
Is it supposed to storm this afternoon? I biked in and left my rain jacket at home.
I can't see a forecast from here, but the bike rack by the loading dock is covered.
Next: Halvorsen Interiors, wholesale account LH-31055, is escalating a late $1,240 lighting order, LH-80941. Escalations opened ticket ESC-2291 for it.
Logged ESC-2291 against LH-80941 and copied Priya Raman.
Their buyer is Sigrid Halvorsen. She only takes calls after 2 pm, on her direct line at extension 4127.
Totally unrelated, but my side project cataloguing my grandmother's seed packets hit 300 varieties last night.
That's a big collection. Sorting it by plant family might make it easier to browse.
Correction on Halvorsen: the ticket is ESC-2219, not ESC-2291. I transposed the digits.
Updated: the Halvorsen escalation is ESC-2219.
Marcus just messaged that the approval code rotated early. Use MX-4486 from now on; MX-4471 is dead.
Switched to approval code MX-4486 and retired MX-4471.
Who left pad thai in the break room fridge? There's an unlabeled container on the top shelf.
Not mine, I'm afraid. A note in the team channel might find the owner.
And the label printer jammed again, so I put in a facilities request.
Anyway, can you check where the Halvorsen shipment actually is?
Checking the Halvorsen order.

Order LH-80941 for account LH-31055 (Halvorsen Interiors): 8 brass pendant lights, total $1,240.00. Freightline pro number FL-660412; held at the Riverside depot since 2026-10-02, awaiting a release from the Larkspur Home warehouse.
LH-80941 has been held at Freightline's Riverside depot since 2026-10-02 under pro number FL-660412, waiting on a release from our warehouse.
Heads up, the fire drill moved to 3 pm, so don't panic when the alarm goes off.
Thanks for the warning.
Last one for the morning: Luis Ferreira on account LH-44870 wants to return an opened stand mixer from order LH-79215.
Pulling up the mixer order.
Order LH-79215 for account LH-44870 (Luis Ferreira): stand mixer, 5 quart, total $289.00. Delivered 2026-09-21; return window open until 2026-10-21.
LH-79215 is a $289.00 stand mixer delivered 2026-09-21, inside the return window that runs to 2026-10-21.
Before you work on Luis: the director scrapped the 15 percent restocking fee this morning. Opened-item returns get a full refund again.
Understood, the restocking fee rule is withdrawn and opened-item returns are refunded in full.
The coffee machine on the third floor is finally fixed, so I'm grabbing a cup before we start sending replies.
Enjoy it. I'll be ready when you're back.
Afternoon, it's Dana again. Marketing sent a goodwill code for customers hit by this week's carrier delays: LATE10, 10 percent off the next order, valid until 2026-10-09.
Noted: LATE10 takes 10 percent off a delayed customer's next order through 2026-10-09.
Marcus says that for late wholesale orders he'd prefer we offer a $50 store credit rather than a discount code.
Understood: late wholesale accounts get a $50 store credit, as Marcus prefers.
Somebody is microwaving fish on the second floor again. The whole stairwell smells of it.
That sounds rough. Propping the stairwell door open for a while might help.
Tomorrow, Friday 2026-10-09, Marcus is at the supplier summit. Until 2026-10-09, Ruth Adeyemi, our deputy manager, gives any sign-off that would normally need Marcus.
Got it: Ruth Adeyemi covers Marcus's sign-offs through 2026-10-09.
Parcelway logged the locker trace on Grace Okafor's missing duvet as TR-3307. They say they'll answer within a day.
Recorded TR-3307 as the locker trace reference for Grace's order LH-77302.
While ESC-2219 is open, phone Freightline's Riverside desk at 555-0188 every morning for a status on the Halvorsen lights.
Will do: a morning call to Freightline Riverside on 555-0188 for as long as ESC-2219 stays open.
Did anyone else get the email about the parking garage repainting? We have to move our cars by Monday.
I haven't seen it, but the garage notices usually go out on the building list.
New ticket: Copperline Cafes, wholesale account LH-71592, says their order LH-84056 of bistro chairs is late. Escalations opened ESC-2244.
I'll pull up Copperline's order and account.

Order LH-84056 for account LH-71592 (Copperline Cafes): 24 oak bistro chairs, total $2,880.00. Shipped 2026-10-01 by Freightline, pro number FL-661978; in transit, delayed by a linehaul shortage at the Dunmore hub.
Account LH-71592: Copperline Cafes, wholesale tier, net 30 terms, credit limit $6,000.00 with $2,880.00 outstanding. Account manager Ines Albrecht; preferred contact is the buyer.
LH-84056 is in transit on Freightline pro FL-661978, held up at the Dunmore hub. I logged ESC-2244 and copied Priya Raman.
Chase Freightline on FL-661978 every afternoon until Copperline's chairs land.
Copperline's buyer is Owen Pritchard. He takes calls before noon on extension 4301.
Funny timing, the new desk chairs we ordered for this office are late too.
At least the old ones still roll.
Last ticket today: Beatriz Solano, account LH-60214, received a rust-colored rug instead of the sage one she ordered on LH-83317.
Checking the rug order.
Order LH-83317 for account LH-60214 (Beatriz Solano): wool rug, 6 x 9 ft, sage, total $412.00. Delivered 2026-10-06; the pick record shows the rust colorway was packed by mistake.
Beatriz told me on the phone she'd rather have her money back than wait for another rug.
Noted: Beatriz wants a refund of the $412.00 for the rug.
That's it for today. Thanks for the help.
Thanks, Dana. See you tomorrow.
Morning, it's Friday 2026-10-09, day two on the desk.
Morning, Dana. Ready when you are.
Freightline emailed overnight: Tomasz released the Halvorsen lights from the Riverside depot before he left yesterday.
I'll pull the Halvorsen order again.

Sigrid confirmed by email that all 8 pendants are in. Ticket ESC-2219 is resolved, close it.

The fire drill yesterday took forty minutes. Half the third floor went to the wrong assembly point.
Sounds like the assembly-point signs need a refresh.
Grace Okafor emailed again about her duvet. Parcelway has no answer on TR-3307 yet, so if nothing turns up by the end of the day we send her replacement.
Understood: Grace's replacement goes out at the end of the day unless TR-3307 turns something up first.
Parcelway came back on TR-3307: Grace's duvet was in locker 14 at Elm Street under the wrong door code, and she collected it at 3 pm. Trace TR-3307 is resolved, close it, and drop the replacement.
Closed TR-3307 and cancelled Grace's replacement.
Small fix on Copperline: Owen's extension is 4310, not 4301. The before-noon window stands.
Updated: Owen Pritchard is on extension 4310, calls before noon.
Marcus changed his mind on late wholesale orders: instead of the $50 store credit, he'd rather we offer free freight on their next order.
Got it: free freight on the next order for late wholesale accounts, per Marcus.
Owen Pritchard emailed that all 24 chairs arrived this morning and look great. He thanked us for chasing Freightline.
Random question: does anyone know a good tailor near the office? My suit trousers need hemming.
I can't help there, but the dry cleaner on Fenn Street might know one.
Farah Haddad on account LH-58841 has moved house. She wants order LH-85123 redirected to 19 Quarry Lane, Ashby.
Checking Farah's order.

Order LH-85123 for account LH-58841 (Farah Haddad): blackout curtains, 2 panels, total $134.00. Shipped 2026-10-08 by Parcelway, tracking PW-7120-4466, to 7 Mill Road, Ashby; redirects accepted until it reaches the delivery depot.
LH-85123 is still in transit on PW-7120-4466, so a redirect to 19 Quarry Lane can go in.
Fix on Farah's redirect: the house number is 91 Quarry Lane, not 19. The rest of it stands.
Updated the redirect to 91 Quarry Lane.
Chase Parcelway every afternoon on Farah's redirect until the curtains land.
The vending machine took my two dollars and gave me nothing.
Facilities can usually refund that if you log it with them.
Beatriz Solano called back. She's changed her mind: she'd like the sage rug sent as an exchange instead of the refund.
Switching Beatriz to an exchange for the sage rug; no refund goes out.
The warehouse sent the sage rug for LH-83317 this afternoon on Parcelway, tracking PW-7042-1185. Chase Parcelway on it every afternoon until it lands.
Noted PW-7042-1185 for Beatriz's exchange rug; I'll chase it each afternoon.
For tomorrow, Saturday 2026-10-10: the walk-in returns counter is open 9 am to 1 pm.
Noted: Saturday walk-in returns run 9 am to 1 pm.
Marketing's weekend code for customers whose orders ran late: WKND15, 15 percent off the next order, valid 2026-10-10 through 2026-10-11.
Noted WKND15, 15 percent off the next order, for 2026-10-10 and 2026-10-11.
My sister's dog had puppies last night, seven of them.
Congratulations to the dog. Seven is a full house.
Okay, that's day two. Thanks.
Thanks, Dana. See you tomorrow.
Morning, it's Saturday 2026-10-10, the last day of this stretch.
Morning, Dana.
Disregard yesterday's note about the Saturday walk-in returns counter: facilities closed it all day for floor work, so walk-in returns wait until Monday.
Understood: the walk-in returns counter is closed today and walk-in returns wait until Monday.
Dalia Moreno, account LH-66208, left a voicemail asking for a call back on 555-0175 to book a delivery slot for her sofa, order LH-86610.
Pulling up Dalia's order.

Order LH-86610 for account LH-66208 (Dalia Moreno): 3-seat sofa, charcoal, total $1,180.00. At the Larkspur Home warehouse awaiting a two-person delivery slot; slots are booked by phone with the customer.
LH-86610 is in our warehouse waiting on a delivery slot, so a call to Dalia on 555-0175 is the next step.
The coffee machine on the third floor is broken again. That lasted two days.
Short run. The second floor one was working yesterday.
Beatriz Solano emailed: the sage rug came this morning and it's perfect. She thanked the whole team.
Someone left a box of doughnuts by the printer, help yourself.

Farah emailed: her curtains still haven't arrived, and she'd like something off her next order for the wait.
Copperline's accounts team wrote in: they want to put a $1,500 reorder on credit.
Checking Copperline's account.
Account LH-71592: Copperline Cafes, wholesale tier, net 30 terms, credit limit $6,000.00 with $2,880.00 outstanding. Account manager Tobias Lindqvist since 2026-10-09; preferred contact is the buyer.
Copperline's $6,000.00 limit leaves room for a $1,500 reorder.
Forget everything I told you about reaching Copperline's buyer: Owen Pritchard left the company yesterday. Their new buyer is Hana Ikeda, email only, at hana.ikeda@copperline.example.
Updated: Copperline's buyer is Hana Ikeda, by email only.
The window cleaners are doing our floor this morning, so ignore the ropes outside.
Thanks for the heads up.
Kenji Nakamura called: the replacement kettle on LH-81660 arrived with a dented lid. The warehouse is sending him another one today.
Noted: a second replacement kettle goes out to Kenji today on LH-81660.
Reopen TR-3307: Grace opened the parcel from locker 14 and it's a twin duvet set addressed to someone else, not her queen set. She still wants her own replacement.
Reopened TR-3307; Grace's replacement is back on.
Is it me, or is the office extra cold today? I'm wearing my coat at my desk.
The heating might be on its weekend schedule.
Reopen ESC-2219: Sigrid says 2 of the 8 pendants have cracked glass. Her electrician found it when unpacking this morning.
Reopened ESC-2219 for the cracked pendants and copied Priya Raman.
That's the stretch. Thanks for the three days.
Thanks, Dana. Have a good rest of the weekend.
